I'm wanting to change up the game interface and behavior a little bit. Rather than using typically numbers and a bankroll I want to use something more 'surreal' ways of counting the wins.

AXEL — Combat Screen UI Implementation Spec
1. Overall layout & frame
Build a single full-screen scene with a centered rectangular "combat frame" as the parent container. All UI lives inside this frame. Use an aspect-locked container (recommend 16:10 or 4:3 portrait-leaning) so the layout doesn't break on widescreen.
Inside the frame, use a 3-column × 3-row CSS grid (or equivalent layout container) with these track sizes:
columns: [log] minmax(72px, 12%)  [center] 1fr  [items] minmax(72px, 12%)
rows:    [bet] auto  [play] 1fr  [meta] auto
The center column carries the active gameplay; the side columns are persistent info panels.
2. Region-by-region spec
2.1 Betting bar — top, full-width inside frame

Grid placement: row bet, columns log → items (spans all three).
Purpose: visual bet selector. NOT a numeric input.
Implementation: horizontal flex row of 5–7 segmented "chip" buttons of increasing size and color saturation (smallest left, biggest right). Selected chip = full opacity + glow ring; unselected = 60% opacity. Tapping a chip sets currentBet.
Height: ~8% of frame height. Keep margin above the grid so it reads as outside the play area.
Optional flourish: thin animated line under the selected chip that pulses softly.

2.2 Spin log — left column

Grid placement: row play, column log.
Purpose: vertical history of matched symbols this encounter (most recent on top).
Implementation: vertical scrollable container, fixed width (~10–12% of frame), full height of the play row. Inside is a flex column of small symbol tiles (recommend 32–40px square), each tile = one matched symbol. Stack newest at top, push older down. Cap at ~25 visible; older entries can fade out or scroll.
Visual style: thin border, slightly inset/darker background than the surrounding frame. Each tile gets a subtle drop animation when added (translateY from -10px, 150ms ease-out).
Header: small label "MATCHED" at the top of the column, ~10px font.

2.3 Play grid — center, main area

Grid placement: row play, column center.
Purpose: the 5×5 slot grid where symbols spawn and cascade.
Implementation:

Use CSS grid (or GridContainer in Godot) with 5 columns × 5 rows, equal cells (aspect-ratio: 1).
Cell size: scale to fill the available space; ~80–110px on desktop.
Each cell renders a SymbolDef texture. Empty cells render as faint dashed/semi-transparent placeholder.
The grid should sit inside a slightly darker inset panel with a thin border to visually separate it from the frame background.
Gap between cells: ~4px.

2.4 Items panel — right column

Grid placement: row play, column items.
Purpose: mirror of the spin log — vertical list of currently held run items.
Implementation: identical container dimensions and styling to the spin log (mirrored layout — symmetry matters). Inside, render each held item as a tile showing the item's icon. Tile size matches the log tiles.
Interaction: hovering/long-pressing an item shows a small tooltip popup with display_name and description.
Header: small label "ITEMS" at the top.
Empty state: show 3–5 faint outlined placeholder slots so the panel is never empty-looking.

2.5 Progress bar — inside grid, at its bottom edge

Placement: anchored to the bottom of the play grid (the inset grid panel, not the outer frame). It's a horizontal bar flush against the grid's bottom border.
Purpose: encounter progress toward the active goal (or spin budget remaining — your call; spec it as progress value 0..1).
Implementation: thin horizontal bar (height ~6–10px), full width of the grid. Inner fill animates left-to-right on update (200ms ease). Use a distinct accent color so it reads as a separate UI element from the grid cells.
Optional: small text label centered over the bar: "GOAL: 3/8" or similar — only if the goal is countable.

2.6 Spin button — between grid and multiplier

Placement: row meta, column center, top half. Horizontally centered.
Implementation: large round button (~64–80px diameter), distinct primary color, with the word "SPIN" or an icon. Disabled state during spin resolution (greyed + spinner). Hover = subtle scale 1.05; press = scale 0.95.
Keyboard binding: Space.

2.7 Multiplier counter — bottom center, outside grid

Placement: row meta, column center, below the spin button. Same column-width as the grid above it.
Purpose: display current spin's multiplier value (e.g., x1, x2, x5).
Implementation: wide short rectangle (~30–40% width of grid, ~50px tall). Large numeric display in the center, e.g., ×3. Bold, high-contrast.
Animation: on multiplier increment, the number "punches" — scale up to 1.3 then back to 1.0 over 250ms, with a color flash. At high multipliers (>10x), add a subtle red/amber glow.

3. Visual hierarchy & styling

Symmetry is the structural promise of this layout. Left log and right items panel must be exact mirrors in dimensions, padding, border, and header treatment. Any asymmetry will read as a bug.
The grid is the focal point. Everything else has lower contrast. Side panels are ~70% of the grid's brightness.
Frame: the outer rectangle is a thick (~3–4px) border with rounded corners (~12px). It bounds everything and is the visible "tabletop" of the game.

4. State & data bindings
Each region subscribes to its slice. Animations are driven by state diffs (new entry in spinLog → drop animation; multiplier change → punch animation).
5. Responsive behavior

Below ~700px wide, collapse the side panels to ~48px and hide their headers — keep them as compact stacks of icons only.
Below ~500px, stack vertically: bet bar → grid → progress → spin button → multiplier → log and items go below as horizontal scrollable rows.

6. What's explicitly NOT in this view
Do not add: a balance display, a settings cog, a pause button, a goal description box, or a princess portrait. Those belong to a separate HUD layer (see AXEL_combat_implementation.md §10) and shouldn't pollute the screenshot-of-the-sketch implementation.

Some of these instructions don't follow the canon parameters, ask about any differences before implementing the plan.

The progress bar works as the premium circle meter.
The numbers below the grid are not counting payroll but how many times of the win the player gets. So it counts multiplier of initial bet.
You choose a section from the top betting bar, and it is animated to fill back up as the payroll increases.
This also means that we shouold remove numbers appearing on top of matched symbols as that isn't valid anymore

Preserve AI_DOCS mechanical invariants (5x5 grid, line wins, deterministic flow) and remove per-symbol numeric payout popups.
input.plan:
# AXEL Surreal Combat UI + Win Logic Plan

## Canon Alignment
- No hard conflict with `AI_DOCS.md` combat invariants (5x5 grid, deterministic RNG flow, line resolution, wild rules, multiplier progression).
- Intentional override (approved): replace prior HUD conventions from implementation notes (bankroll/budget-heavy readouts) with surreal chip-health + 10x chip-bar goal semantics.
- Keep gameplay core in [`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd) while changing UI and encounter target semantics.

## Confirmed Decisions To Implement
- Bottom readout shows **spin win multiple of selected chip bet** (per-spin ratio, resets each spin).
- Bankroll numbers are removed from visible UI; economy is represented as **chip-bar health/fill**.
- Top chip selection animates fill by **per-spin win ratio**.
- Goal text remains visible as: **win 10x the entire chip-bar** (10 sections total), and this is a **real win condition replacement** for this mode.
- Budget text is removed.
- Per-symbol numeric popups on matches are removed.

## File Impact Map
- UI shell scene/layout: [`AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`](AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn)
- UI bindings/controller: [`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd)
- Core combat data/events and payout summary plumbing: [`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd)
- Grid visual host scene adjustments (if needed for inset/progress anchor): [`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn`](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn)
- Symbol popup removal fallback/no-op point: [`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/symbol_slot.gd`](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/symbol_slot.gd)

## Implementation Steps
1. **Rebuild combat shell layout into framed 3x3 macro grid**
   - In `combat_test.tscn`, create centered combat frame with rows: bet bar / play area / meta area.
   - Add mirrored left `MATCHED` panel and right `ITEMS` panel with equal sizing/padding.
   - Keep center play area dedicated to the existing 5x5 symbol grid (no grid-size mechanic change).

2. **Replace top controls with segmented surreal chip bar**
   - Replace +/- stake buttons and numeric stake text with 10-section chip strip.
   - Selecting a section maps to current bet index/value and sets active chip style.
   - Add per-spin fill animation (driven by spin win ratio) to selected chip segment.

3. **Remove bankroll/budget readouts and rebind goal copy**
   - Remove `BANKROLL` and `SPIN LOG/BUDGET` labels from visible UI.
   - Add goal label text mode: `GOAL: WIN 10x CHIP-BAR` plus compact live progress ratio.
   - Ensure goal progress is computed against new 10x full-bar target.

4. **Add matched-symbol log + items mirror behavior**
   - Left panel: append matched symbol tiles newest-first from spin resolution diffs.
   - Right panel: mirror container style and render held item tiles with tooltip metadata.
   - Add placeholder slots for empty `ITEMS` state to maintain symmetry.

5. **Add bottom meta stack (progress + spin + multiplier panel)**
   - Progress bar anchored to bottom of center grid panel and bound to premium-meter proxy.
   - Spin button centered and disabled during resolution (Space key preserved).
   - Bottom multiplier readout changed to show per-spin `win / selected_bet` value (e.g., `x3.4`).

6. **Core logic updates for new win condition + popup removal**
   - In `combat_root.gd`, expose/compute values needed for chip fill + per-spin ratio readouts.
   - Replace encounter success rule for this mode: win when cumulative target reaches 10x full chip-bar requirement.
   - Remove calls that show per-symbol numeric popup labels during line resolve.

7. **Responsive behavior implementation**
   - `<700px`: narrow side panels, hide headers.
   - `<500px`: stack bet -> grid -> progress -> spin -> multiplier; side panels become horizontal rows.

8. **Validation**
   - Run existing combat headless checks and update any expectations impacted by goal semantics/UI signal wiring.
   - Manual smoke in `combat_test.tscn`: chip select, spin lock, panel symmetry, progress updates, no match popups, new goal completion.

## Data Flow (Planned)
```mermaid
flowchart TD
chipSelect[ChipSectionSelected] --> setBet[SetCurrentBet]
spinResolve[SpinResolved] --> spinPayout[SpinPayoutValue]
setBet --> spinRatio[ComputeSpinWinRatio]
spinPayout --> spinRatio
spinRatio --> chipFill[AnimateSelectedChipFill]
spinRatio --> bottomReadout[UpdateBottomMultiplierPanel]
spinResolve --> matchedLog[AppendMatchedSymbolsLeftPanel]
meterState[PremiumMeterSections] --> progressBar[UpdateGridBottomProgressBar]
encounterAccum[AccumulatedEncounterProgress] --> goalCheck[Check10xChipBarWin]
goalCheck --> encounterEnd[EncounterWinOrContinue]
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- Center frame follows requested three-region structure and symmetry constraints.
- No visible bankroll or budget text; chip-health abstraction is the economy readout.
- Matched symbols appear in left log; items appear in right mirrored panel.
- Progress bar acts as premium-circle proxy and animates correctly.
- Bottom readout reflects per-spin win multiple of selected chip bet.
- Encounter win condition uses 10x full chip-bar target mode.
- Numeric popups above matched symbols are removed.
- Existing combat core invariants remain intact (5x5, line wins, deterministic spin pipeline).

### UI (`combat_test.tscn` + `combat_test.gd`)
- Centered **combat frame** with chip bar (10 segments), **MATCHED** log (left), **ITEMS** panel (right), grid center, round **SPIN** button, and **×N** readout (per-spin win ÷ selected bet).

- Dev item picker kept top-left for playtest equipping.

### Core logic (`combat_root.gd`)
- Chip-bar economy: **10 sections**, **$10.00** full bar (`1000` cents).
- Encounter win: accumulate **10×** full bar in winnings (`$100.00` target).
- Fail when chip health can’t afford the next spin.
- `matched_symbols_resolved` signal for the left log.
- Per-symbol **currency popups removed** (flash FX kept).

### New scripts
- `chip_bar_segment.gd` — chip UI + fill animation  
- `matched_log_tile.gd` — log/item tiles  

### Verification
- `princess_check.gd` — OK  
- `determinism_check.gd` — OK

# Combat Test v1/v2 Versioning Plan

## Goal
Preserve the old numbered interface as a clean backup (`v1`) and implement the surreal interface as `v2`, with `v2` set as the default test entrypoint.

## Confirmed Decisions
- Preserve v1 by duplicating **both** scene and script.
- Set `v2` as the default test entrypoint.

## Files To Touch
- [`AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`](AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn)
- [`AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd)

- [`AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md`](AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md)
- New backup/readme note file under combat test area (e.g. `combat/README_COMBAT_TEST_VERSIONS.md`)

## Implementation Steps
1. Snapshot current old UI version into:
   - `combat_test_v1.tscn`
   - `scripts/combat_test_v1.gd`
2. Create new surreal branch as:
   - `combat_test_v2.tscn`
   - `scripts/combat_test_v2.gd`
3. Point default entry to `v2` by making `combat_test.tscn` a thin alias/wrapper or direct copy of `combat_test_v2.tscn` (same for script mapping if needed).
4. Add rollback documentation describing:
   - What v1 contains (bankroll/budget/numeric style)
   - What v2 contains (chip-bar/surreal UI)
   - Exact swap steps to revert default to v1.
5. Ensure tests and manual launch commands still work with v2 default and explicitly mention how to launch v1 manually.
6. Append changelog entry with hierarchy override note and versioning rationale.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `v1` and `v2` both exist as separate scene+script pairs.
- Default test launch opens v2 behavior.
- A clear in-repo note explains old vs new UI and rollback steps.
- Existing combat checks pass after path updates.
- Changelog records the version split and revert strategy.

# Combat Test UI Versions

Two playtest shells share the same `CombatRoot` mechanics scene; only the HUD shell differs.

## Versions

| Version | Scene | Script | UI style |
|---------|-------|--------|----------|
| **v2 (default)** | `res://combat/combat_test.tscn` | `scripts/combat_test_v2.gd` | Surreal chip-bar: 10 segments, MATCHED/ITEMS panels, ×N spin readout, premium progress bar, no bankroll/budget labels |
| **v1 (backup)** | `res://combat/combat_test_v1.tscn` | `scripts/combat_test_v1.gd` | Numeric HUD: BANKROLL, STAKE +/-, SPIN LOG, AMPLIFIER, premium **circle** meter, left dev item picker |

`combat_test.gd` is a thin alias that `extends` `combat_test_v2.gd` for backward-compatible paths.

## Launch

- **Default (v2):** open `combat/combat_test.tscn` → **F6** (Play Scene).
- **Legacy UI (v1):** open `combat/combat_test_v1.tscn` → **F6**.

Headless combat checks (`princess_check`, `determinism_check`) use `combat_root.tscn` only — not these shells.

## Revert default entry to v1

1. In `combat/combat_test.tscn`, change the root script ext_resource to `res://combat/scripts/combat_test_v1.gd`.
2. Or point F5/F6 at `combat_test_v1.tscn` instead of `combat_test.tscn`.
3. Optional: change `combat_test.gd` to `extends "res://combat/scripts/combat_test_v1.gd"` instead of v2.

## What v1 preserved (snapshot from git `0ba177e`)

- Top-center **BANKROLL** and **STAKE** with `-` / `+` buttons
- Top-right **goal** progress from encounter `GoalTracker`
- Bottom-left **SPIN LOG** (lifetime spins)
- Right **PremiumMeterCircle** (3-section ring) + **AMPLIFIER** cascade multiplier readout
- Wide bottom **EXECUTE** button
- Programmatic left **ITEMS** dev picker (checkbox list)
- Per-symbol **currency popups** on wins (via `combat_root` FX at time of snapshot; core may have moved on)

## What v2 adds

- Centered combat frame, chip-bar bet selector, mirrored MATCHED / ITEMS columns
- Per-spin **×N** readout (win ÷ selected bet), not bankroll
- Encounter goal: **win 10× full chip-bar** (wired in `combat_root.gd`)
- Premium meter as horizontal bar under grid
- No numeric popups on matched cells

## Note on shared `combat_root`

Both shells instance the same `combat_root.tscn`. Economy/goal logic in `combat_root.gd` follows the **v2 chip-bar** model (10-section bar, 10× goal). v1 restores the **old HUD layout** but readouts like goal text may reflect current core logic unless a legacy mode flag is added later.
